[EN] This base was the center of our world. Those who survived dangerous missions during the first expedition came to regard it as "home." Now it is little more than ashes, and this one longs for happier days.
[ES] Esta base era el centro de nuestro mundo. Aquellos que sobrevivieron a misiones peligrosas durante la primera expedición llegaron a considerarla su «hogar». Ahora no es más que cenizas, y este anhela días más felices.
